profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and traded under the ticker SMCI. On its website it describes itself as the premier provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, data center, cloud, enterprise, big data, HPC and embedded markets worldwide. The site covers data center servers, blades, data storage and AI systems.

Its site markets GPU servers for modern data centers and describes its AI systems as featuring the latest multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also lists short-depth and small form factor systems intended to deliver compute, AI and connectivity performance at the edge of the network.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are listed.
